recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-32466; any future terminology work on the unbound audit-entity-type value set should be handled separately.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 Security issue objecting that AuditEvent.entity.type used an extensible value set with overlapping resource-type and DICOM identifier-style codes; final resolution was to remove entity.type because entity.what is a Reference.
initial_application: The structural change was applied in the same AuditEvent block-vote family, chiefly through 1495aa7007492c9a1406bcaac23a3becdbdedadf for FHIR-32467, which removed AuditEvent.entity.type and moved ParticipantObjectTypeCode to entity.what. The later 3d204189e23e03f0b4f11d03d491bc1d868e399b block-vote update included FHIR-32466 in the applied change set.
additional_context: FHIR-12677 is the earlier issue that added FHIR Resource types to the entity type vocabulary; FHIR-32466 supersedes that mechanism by eliminating the element. Security WG Confluence minutes and the linked Zulip block-vote thread list FHIR-32466 as Persuasive in the September 13, 2021 AuditEvent block vote. FHIR-32467 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source has no AuditEvent.entity.type element or authoritative stale guidance, and source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml defines entity.what as Reference(Resource) with the ParticipantObjectTypeCode mapping.
